Pinegrass Technologies Private Limited ("Pinegrass", "we", "our", "us") operates the Ari mobile application ("Ari" or the "Service"). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use Ari.
We are committed to protecting your privacy and complying with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDPA) of India and other applicable data protection laws.

When you sign up, we collect your name, email address, and authentication credentials via Apple, Google Sign-In, or email/password. Your authentication is managed through Supabase. Apple may provide a private relay email address if you choose Hide My Email.
You provide transaction details including amounts, categories, merchants, dates, and payment methods. This data is essential for Ari to provide budgeting, tracking, and insights.
If you use voice input, your speech is transcribed on-device or through a secure service. Voice recordings are not stored.
We collect anonymised app usage statistics (screens visited, features used) via PostHog to improve Ari. No financial data is sent to analytics.

We store the last time your account used Ari, notification cadence state, your invite code, invite share count, and accepted invite attribution. We do not reveal your financial data to invited users or inviters.
Push notification tokens, device model, and OS version are collected for crash reporting (Sentry) and notification delivery.
• To provide and maintain the Ari service
• To categorise transactions, generate budgets, and deliver financial insights
• To send opted-in reminders, budget alerts, reports, and limited re-engagement messages
• To attribute invite codes and show circle milestones
• To improve Ari through anonymised usage analytics
• To detect and prevent fraud, abuse, or security incidents

Ari's AI coach ("Tomo") may process your transaction data to provide personalised financial guidance. Before any data is sent to an AI provider, personally identifiable information (PII) such as account numbers, card details, and full names are stripped. AI requests are ephemeral and not used to train models.
We use the following third-party services:

Your data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). We use Supabase's managed infrastructure with regular security updates. You may enable biometric lock (Face ID / fingerprint) in Settings for an additional layer of device-level security.

We retain your data for as long as your account is active. You may delete your account at any time from Settings → Delete Account. Account deletion permanently removes your personal data, transaction history, budgets, and associated records within 30 days. Some anonymised aggregate data may be retained for legal compliance.
To request data export or deletion, contact us at privacy@pinegrass.in.
Under India's DPDP Act, you have the right to:
• Access a summary of your personal data
• Nominate a representative for your data rights
• Grievance redressal through our Grievance Officer
Ari is not intended for users under 18. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, contact us immediately.

This Privacy Policy explains how Pinegrass Technologies Pvt Ltd ("Pinegrass", "we", "us") collects, uses, and protects information when you use Ari, our AI money coach mobile application ("the App"), and the aritomo.in website ("the Site").
Account information: name, email address, and a user identifier when you sign up via email/password or Google Sign-In.
Financial information: the transactions, budgets, categories, and notes you enter into the App. This is the core data the App is designed to help you manage.
Communications: any feedback or support requests you send us.
App activity: interactions with App features, including which screens you visit and which actions you take. Collected via PostHog for product analytics.
App performance: crash logs, diagnostic information, and performance metrics. Collected via Sentry to help us identify and fix issues.
Device identifiers: a unique device or installation ID used by analytics and crash reporting.
Approximate location: city or region-level location may be inferred from your IP address for regional defaults (currency, language). We do not collect precise GPS location.

Voice recordings: voice input in the App is transcribed entirely on your device. Audio is not transmitted to our servers.
Contacts, photos, messages, calendar, browsing history, health data, or any other data category not listed above.
